summary: Iteration 35 — Player self-certify + Rounds-router extraction + Compliance user_id column. Backend 22/22 PASS. iter34 regression 17/17 PASS (total 39/39 pytest green). Self-certify endpoint honors all spec rules: 401 unauth, 404 unknown scorecard, 403 non-owner (both league-member trying to certify someone else's card AND non-member outsider), 200 for owner. Idempotent — second call returns {ok:true, already_certified:true, player_certified:true} with NO duplicate ProofLog row (verified by pre/post count on db.proof_logs). DB side-effects verified: scorecards row has player_certified=true, player_certified_at set, player_certified_by_uid == user.user_id. proof_logs has exactly ONE new row with edited_by_name matching 'PLAYER-CERTIFIED'. Compliance dashboard reflects self-cert instantly: after 1 owner certifies, certified_count=1, can_sweep_finalize=false, pending_certification shrinks from 3→2. After all 3 certify, certified_count=3, can_sweep_finalize=true, pending_certification=[]. Both outstanding_members[] and pending_certification[] rows now carry user_id. Rounds-router extraction (leagues_rounds_router.py) is bit-perfect: chat POST/GET (401/404/403/200 + response shape verified), director-notes PATCH (401/403/200 + persistence via GET /rounds/{id}), CTP POST/GET/DELETE (401/400 for invalid hole & inches>=12/200 + leaderboard sort verified — best distance first). Route-registry test confirms every moved route + new certify route is mounted EXACTLY ONCE on app.routes (no double-registration from the tail-import). leagues_router.py line count = 1,647 (spec target hit). Frontend loads clean with no console errors. RoundScorecard self-certify button + 'You OK'd' badge and ComplianceTab DM chips have proper data-testids and correct conditional logic (verified via code review — button gated by isMine && !alreadyCertified; DM disabled when user_id null with toast fallback).
critical_code_review_comments: Self-certify endpoint (leagues_router.py:919) — clean owner check via `sc.member_id == membership.id`. Correctly rejects a director trying to self-certify someone else's card (spec compliant — directors have the separate finalize path). Idempotent branch returns early BEFORE writing the ProofLog, which is why no dup row is created — good.

leagues_rounds_router.py — matches the tail-import pattern established by clubhouse/ledger/compliance. All 6 endpoints import from .leagues_router (api_router, db, get_current_user, ws_manager, _require_member, model classes). Zero double-registration confirmed by iterating app.routes.

Compliance response now carries user_id on both outstanding_members and pending_certification rows (fields nullable when member.user_id is missing). Frontend correctly disables the DM button + shows a toast in that case (ComplianceTab.jsx:47 checks !user_id).

CTP leaderboard shape ({entries, leaderboard, ctp_holes}) is correct. Note: leaderboard is keyed by hole int server-side and gets serialised to a JSON object with STRING keys — frontend consumers must key with String(hole). Not a bug, but worth documenting on the client side.

Minor: player self-certify handler stamps `edited_by_name = f'{user.name} · PLAYER-CERTIFIED'`. If user.name is empty (e.g. Firebase user hasn't set a display name), the log row could look like ' · PLAYER-CERTIFIED'. Fine functionally, but a defensive `or user.email` would look nicer in the audit UI.

success_rate.frontend: not e2e tested — code review only (per iter scope: 'Do NOT re-test frontend UI beyond the 2 new components'). Frontend loads clean, no console errors.
